description: Collected judgment-call follow-ups from q67.1/q67.3 audits, deferred because they touch code outside those diffs: (1) narrow StorageRacing's blanket rescue RuntimeError (storage_racing.ex:55) — it mislabels operation_fn RuntimeErrors on the cached-fastest in-process path as layout_lookup_failed; (2) placeholder restart has no intensity limit — malformed request (racing_key FunctionClauseError) can crash-cycle it and dump parked waiters each time; add crash counter/backoff and/or a defensive clause replying {:error, :invalid_request}; (3) healthy-TSL invariant: once placeholder fills all slots, assert built indexes never contain []-pid segments; (4) doc nit: lookup_key!/lookup_range @docs should state pids may be []; (5) thread hold_ms config through distributor restart instead of default_hold_ms().
title: StorageRacing/placeholder hardening: narrow rescue, restart backoff, invariant check
